records.text: An enemy school has killed your master and all your companions. You are the last survivor who can avenge them
Unknown killers have murdered your father. You must find your brothers and seek revenge
Strange animal attacks on a mountain pass threaten trade
A ghost haunts a palace, making life impossible for its inhabitants
Nomads from the north have attacked a village on the border; the governor is looking for talented men
An isolated village has stopped paying taxes. You are sent to gather information
One city, two martial arts schools at war for decades
You must escort a Mandarin to a newly conquered province
A corrupt official tries to expropriate your family's property
Thieves have stolen a sacred object from a monastery, and the abbot is looking for volunteers to find it
A martial arts tournament is held every year on a remote island; only one will survive
A monk is worshipped as a god. The local deities appear to you in a dream, asking to put an end to it
You wake up to find your family slaughtered, you see only a one-armed figure running away
Although the task is impossible, there is nothing else to do; you must kill the emperor
In a cave hidden by a waterfall, it is said that there are monkeys with magical powers
A nobleman pays you to teach his inept heir how to become strong and brave
You are wrongly accused of murder and there is a bounty on your head
To defeat a demon, you must find an ally and create a new dual technique
The new Manchu emperor is about to launch an attack on the last rebel monastery
Your master has taught his skills to five other people. You must find out if they have turned evil and, if so, kill them
A Japanese warship has just landed on the coast, spreading panic
A troop of European colonialists has occupied a port city and rules it with an iron fist
You are tormented by a spirit and must find a way to get rid of it
You have been struck on a pressure point and will die in 7 days, unless...
You must accompany a Buddhist monk to India to retrieve the sacred scriptures
A village is being preyed upon by bandits. You must teach everyone who is willing to fight in order to stop the next attack
You must infiltrate a criminal organization using an invitation to a tournament as a cover
Bandits have kidnapped the governor's son
On your wedding day, a demon kidnaps your partner
There is a mysterious killer who murders everyone with your surname
A prince seeks your help, an impostor has taken his place
For months, the village's harvests have been poor and the crops rot quickly
You find out that you have an evil twin brother
A pupil attacks you in your sleep. Thought dead, you wake up in your coffin
An enraged dragon causes continuous tsunamis on some coastal villages
